PrivateType is a private, local push-to-talk dictation app for Windows. Hold a shortcut, speak, and release it to insert text into the field where dictation began, without cloud recognition or transcript history.

## New in this release

### 32 recognition languages

- Each shortcut can now use Automatic or any of the 32 languages and regions the local model recognizes out of the box, from English (United States and United Kingdom), Spanish, French, and Portuguese in two regions each, to German, Italian, Dutch, Ukrainian, Russian, Czech, Swedish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), and more.
- Polish and English keep their default shortcuts. Existing shortcuts carry over unchanged.
- The app's own interface stays in English, and the recording status now reads "Listening" in every language.

### Press to start, press again to stop

- **Settings → Shortcuts → Shortcut behavior** can now be **Press to start and stop** instead of holding the shortcut. If the model is still loading, listening starts by itself when it is ready.

### Paste instead of typing

- **Insert text by → Pasting** inserts dictated text through the clipboard. It is faster for long text and works in apps that ignore simulated typing.
- Your previous clipboard is put back afterwards, unless you copied something new in the meantime.
- Dictated text is marked so Windows clipboard history and cloud clipboard skip it.
- **Typing characters** stays the default and never touches the clipboard.

### Updated speech model

- PrivateType now uses NVIDIA's re-converted model file (revision `ea30d66`), which recognizes speech exactly as before and adds the tokenizer needed for upcoming custom vocabulary.
- The first start of this version downloads the model once more (about 708 MiB). The previous copy in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PrivateType\models` is left untouched and can be deleted after closing older versions.

### Settings

- Language names are shown in full, and the remove-shortcut button is now compact.
- Settings are stored in a new format. An older PrivateType version reading these settings would treat every shortcut as Polish; keep each version's own settings folder if you plan to switch back.

## Download and start

1. Download `PrivateType-1.1.0-win-x64.zip` and `PrivateType-1.1.0-win-x64.zip.sha256` below.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder.
4. Open `PrivateType 1.1.0` and double-click `PrivateType.exe`.
5. Approve the separate local speech-model download on first launch if the verified model is not already in the shared cache.

The model is not bundled in the ZIP. PrivateType downloads it directly from NVIDIA on Hugging Face and verifies its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use.

## Requirements

- 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11
- A modern x64 CPU and at least 4 GB RAM; 8 GB or more is recommended
- About 2 GB free disk space for the portable app, model, and working room
- [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015–2022 (x64)](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe)

## Privacy

Speech recognition runs locally. PrivateType has no account, cloud-recognition fallback, telemetry, retained audio, or transcript history. Review diagnostic reports before sharing them because application diagnostics can still contain information about your computer environment.
